instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List what Trillion told this person, newest first: each notice with every way it went (sent, waiting its turn, turned off or unavailable) and the surface the person saw it on", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:my-notices and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Optional limit (up to 100, default 20) and kind (only notices of that kind, such as take-me-there).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: told-the-person (records:list).
